claims.statement: Tom Allen sparred Joe Coburn at a sparring exhibition for Coburn's benefit at Mozart Hall.
claims.excerpt: Joe. Coburn and Tom. Alen. The sparring generally was lively and satisfactory

claims.statement: A benefit for Tom Allen was announced for Saturday night, when his championship belt would be presented.
claims.excerpt: A benefit for Tom. Allen was announced for Saturday night, when the much-talked-of belt

notes: The exhibition is described as 'last night' in a paper dated 26 April, so 25 April. The benefit was announced, not confirmed as held.
